mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL growth > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO growth > 1% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary conditions and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decline > 100,000 does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 1%, or FEDFUNDS < 1% does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.1).
